newsitem.title: UK: Boosey says major shareholder mulling sale.
newsitem.headline: Boosey says major shareholder mulling sale.

text.p: UK music company Boosey & Hawkes Plc said on Wednesday it has been advised that a major shareholder is exploring the possibility of a sale which would involve disposing of its holding in the company.

Carl Fischer Inc (CFI), which holds a 45.3 percent voting interest in Boosey, has authorised its adviser Credit Suisse First Boston Corp to explore a possible sale of CFI, including its shares in Boosey.

Boosey said it is considering alternatives with its adviser Deutsche Morgan Grenfell which would "provide shareholders of CFI with liquidity and shareholders of Boosey and Hawkes with a continuing interest in a listed company.

Any sale of CFI, which has held a substantial stake in Boosey since 1965, would be accompanied by a public offer for all the remaining shares in Boosey, including the 8.2 percent interest held by the Carl Fischer Employees Retirement Income Plan.
CFI is an unquoted company whose main activities are music publishing and jobbing.
